name: Şahin Hürcan
title: Senior Software Engineer
about: Senior Software Engineer with over 6 years of experience across the .NET ecosystem, delivering scalable, high-performance and maintainable software. I convert complex business problems—especially those involving regulatory compliance, high transaction volumes and integration challenges—into robust, production-ready solutions. My work focuses on distributed systems, microservices architectures, message-driven & asynchronous processing, and database optimization. I follow CI/CD, Clean Architecture and rigorous code quality practices, and I continuously adopt new technologies to add measurable value to projects.

experience.description: Contributed as a core development team member to build a modular, extensible insurance platform from the ground up. Implemented CQRS and message-based asynchronous patterns to handle high-throughput scenarios and ensure data consistency. Integrated Redis and MongoDB for performance-focused data access and implemented event-driven components to improve system scalability.

Provided technical leadership and drove infrastructure modernization for an e-commerce platform. Addressed concurrency and transactional integrity challenges during high-traffic campaigns, introduced locking and optimistic strategies, and led a platform upgrade to .NET 6. Defined API standards and versioning to improve integration speed and reliability.

Worked on e-commerce package development, implementing payment gateway integrations, e-invoicing and ERP connectors. Automated recurring and bulk tasks using Quartz.NET and Hangfire to improve operational efficiency.
Developed sector-specific applications that digitized manual business workflows, improving reliability and throughput. Focused on integration and data integrity with SQL Server-based solutions.
Delivered front-end and back-end solutions for web projects, including admin panels and content sites.

education.description: Project-based education with extensive lab work, delivering hands-on experience in large-scale software analysis, design and testing.
